line4: I'm a game developer and UI/UX engineer, passionate about games for as long as I can remember. Today I work at Fun Mage Studio (Singapore) with an international team, building games with Unity, C#, and Unreal Engine.
line5: I've worked on a good range of projects: hack and slash combat systems, real-time multiplayer games with Netcode for GameObjects, Unity Relay and Unity Lobby, crafting and merge mechanics, isometric worlds, and shooters.
line6: I also take care of the interface layer and the player experience: game HUDs and screens designed in Figma, UI animations, and visual feedback for every player action, always with attention to usability, clarity, and accessibility. My front-end background (Vue.js and TypeScript) helps me build responsive, intuitive interfaces.
line7: I like understanding how every piece of a game fits together, from the code behind the mechanics to what the player sees and feels on screen and I'm always learning something new along the way.
